name: Neo Brutal
summary: Neubrutalism collage: paper with a dot grid, footage in thick-bordered cards with zero-blur offset shadows, flat saturated blocks, quirky heavy grotesk + mono tags, cards pushed in and flung out like cut-outs, marker-highlight captions, stepped stop-motion wiggles.
lexicon: hard (zero-blur) offset shadow, thick black stroke
best_for: tools, apps, listicles, tips, playful brands — content that should feel handmade and confident, not glossy
footage: any; it plays in an 840x940 card (cover crop), so the middle 85% of a 9:16 frame is what shows
sfx: a paper swish when a card is flung, a stamp thud on the CTA
